description.value: St. Eugene Golf Resort & Casino is a full-service Indigenous-affiliated resort set within the traditional territory of the Ktunaxa Nation in a secluded valley on the banks of the St. Mary's River, about 10 minutes from downtown Cranbrook. The property features 125 guest rooms and suites with views of Fisher Peak and the Purcell and Rocky Mountains, an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Les Furber, a casino, and on-site dining. Its interpretive centre and Indigenous heritage programming make it a culturally distinctive stop in the East Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms St. Eugene is an active, full-service golf resort and casino with 125 rooms, on-site dining (casual and upscale restaurants), and free Wi-Fi explicitly documented in the FAQ ('Network is SEGRC-Public, no password required'). No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content. The website prominently displays a toll-free number (1.866.292.2020) that differs from the OSM phone (+1-250-420-2000), flagged as a discrepancy.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-250-420-2000; website prominently displays toll-free 1.866.292.2020. Website value used as primary; both may be valid lines.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The resort is a legitimate, operating accommodation near Cranbrook that touring cyclists might use, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) could be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether it meets WWC minimum standards.

Wi-Fi.detail: FAQ states: 'Our WiFi is free to all hotel guests. Network is SEGRC-Public. No password is required.'
